_about: MAP's credit funnel (public.map_college_cr_unit) read for SkyView's CPL face. Structural counts only — no student figure is carried. Read through the Supabase MCP on the date below; refresh by hand when the funnel is reloaded (map-custom-report-load.yml), the daily run does not touch it.
_source: public.map_college_cr_unit joined by exhibit_id to kb/coci_articulations.json (the articulation crosswalk) restricted to identities on prototype/ccr_universe.json
_note: Only 570 of the 1,924 exhibits that reach the map appear in the funnel at all: the funnel is ACE-keyed (6,291 of its 6,388 exhibit ids are ACE exhibits, the JST military record) and the articulation crosswalk is MAP-keyed (industry certification, credit by exam, assessments). They are nearly disjoint exhibit universes, so a coverage line must take its numerator and denominator from the same one — the articulation feed.
